remarks: *DEADLINE FOR OFFERS WEDNESDAY 8/12/26 3PM* Welcome to all the conveniences in the heart of Stamford! Enjoy this beautifully maintained 1 floor 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo. The remodeled kitchen features updated cabinetry, countertops, stainless steel appliances including a brand new dishwasher, and a breakfast bar that opens to the living and dining areas, making it ideal for entertaining. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry, a spacious bedroom with ample closet space, and a front balcony-the perfect spot to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind after a long day. This complex also includes the convenience of one assigned garage parking space plus one exterior guest parking space. The monthly HOA fee includes water and sewer. Ideally situated just minutes from vibrant downtown Stamford, Metro-North, shopping, restaurants, parks, and major commuter routes, this home offers an unbeatable combination of location and low-maintenance living. Whether you're a first-time buyer, downsizing, or looking for one level living this move-in-ready condo is one you won't want to miss! Subject to seller finding suitable housing.
